description: MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=15 from .env overrides code default of 8. System accepts 87.5% more concurrent positions than documented spec.
evidence: .env has ORGANISM_MAX_POSITIONS=15, code default is 8, resolved_config confirms 15
impact_tomorrow: Kelly sizer and risk-budget calculations are tuned for 8 positions. With 15, per-trade risk is spread thinner but total portfolio exposure is higher. Drawdown behavior may differ from spec expectations.
recommended_action: Architect decision: intentional override or drift? If intentional, update spec. If drift, set .env to 8.

description: bar_boundary_entry_only is declared true in resolved_config but NOT enforced in the entry code path. _is_new_bar is computed only in exit path (step 4). Entry path (steps 6-9) has no bar-boundary gate.
evidence: Grep for BAR_BOUNDARY in entry code returns zero hits. _is_new_bar only used at line 1430 (exit check). Config snapshot shows bar_boundary_entry_only=true.
impact_tomorrow: Entries can fire on any of the ~6 sub-ticks within a 1-minute bar. This allows intra-bar whipsaws and may explain trades with 0 bars_held. Timing integrity is degraded.
recommended_action: Architect decision: implement the gate or update spec to false. This is a design question, not a simple bug fix.

description: .env universe has 30 symbols (no SH/PSQ inverse ETFs) vs code default of 22 (with SH/PSQ). Inverse ETF capability is spec'd but not deployed.
evidence: .env: 30 symbols including COIN,SNOW,PLTR,UBER,ABNB,SQ but missing SH,PSQ. Code default: 22 symbols with SH,PSQ.
impact_tomorrow: No inverse ETF participation in bearish tapes. 10 extra volatile symbols (COIN, SNOW, etc.) increase universe noise. SNOW is the single worst performer at -$310.
recommended_action: Architect decision: reconcile .env with code default. Add SH/PSQ if bearish hedging is desired. Consider removing worst-performing additions.

description: entry_source is set correctly in _entry_metadata (alpha/breakout/alpha+breakout) but all 142 trades in brain CSV show empty entry_source. Either the deployed container predates this code or the brain CSV was written before entry_source was populated.
evidence: daily_entry_breakdown.json shows all 142 trades as 'unknown'. Code at line 2223 sets _entry_source='alpha'. Line 3348 reads meta.get('entry_source','').
impact_tomorrow: Cannot attribute PnL to alpha vs breakout entry paths. Strategy debugging is blind. New trades should have entry_source if container has current code.
recommended_action: Verify container image includes entry_source logic. If not, rebuild container. Future trades should populate correctly.

description: Runtime API reports ml_trained=true and total_trades=160, but daily bundle (from brain CSV snapshot) shows ml_trained=false and total_trades=142. Bundle is stale relative to live state.
evidence: API engine.ml_trained=true, engine.total_trades=160. Bundle daily_runtime_snapshot.json: ml_trained=false, total_trades_lifetime=142.
impact_tomorrow: No impact on trading — live engine uses its own state. Bundle forensics are stale. Regenerating the bundle after market close will capture current state.
recommended_action: Regenerate bundle after next market close. Consider automating bundle generation.

description: daily_model_quality acceptance_events shows 0 evaluations. J4 evaluation-event history is not yet deployed (uncommitted). Until deployed, background trainer events are not persisted to evaluation_event_history.json.
evidence: acceptance_events.total_evaluations=0 in bundle. J4+J5 patches in working tree but not committed/deployed.
impact_tomorrow: Model evaluation forensics remain incomplete until J4+J5 are deployed. Trading is unaffected.
recommended_action: Commit J4+J5 patches and rebuild container to enable evaluation-event tracking.

description: BreakoutScanner(top_n=MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=15) while AlphaScanner(top_n=ALPHA_TOP_N=5). Breakout scanner considers 3x more candidates than alpha scanner.
evidence: Line 303: AlphaScanner(top_n=5). Line 304: BreakoutScanner(top_n=15). Both feed into unified candidate list capped at open_slots.
impact_tomorrow: Breakout-sourced candidates may outnumber alpha-sourced 3:1 in the unified ranking. This is likely intentional but worth noting.
recommended_action: No action needed unless alpha signals are being crowded out.
